items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: There was a tenor player named Gypsy -- a white tenor player. He loved Pres -- he played just like him.

ctx.x: Lester Young, the big bands had broke up, you might say; they didn't have too much work, and the leading bars for a combo was a saxophone, and everybody was playing tenors, even -- there were no alto players out there, because Bird seemed to have wiped them off the face of the earth. Really, everybody wanted to play tenor, and some of them were using the technique that Bird was using on the tenors, but that was -- everybody wanted to hear a tenor saxophone -- just everyone.
Do you think people were intimidated by the things that Bird was doing?
